notes.title: Lost in Memory V2.3.1
notes.content:
Lost in Memory V2.3.1

With three games under my belt I got a lot better at making them, Lost in Memory is my first game and I found a lot of problems with it to fix so here's what I fixed

Bug fixes:
-Selecting the new game option will no longer keep memories from your save game.
-The issue that gives you more guilt then intended is fixed so now it's easier to get the rest of all four endings.
-Some areas had issues with the quit game menu option not opening the are you sure menu.
-out of bounds bug in school fixed.
-The car that forces you out of the memories now removes your equipped memory as intended.
-Things like lights and particle systems will no longer be in front of screen transitions.

Quality of life new inputs:
-You can now pause the game with "ESC".
-You can now interact with objects, people and doors with "E".
-You can now use "B" on controller to close the pause menu.

Small changes:-
-Main menu intro has a smoother transition.
-The player animations for "peace sign", "maid" and "rose" have been slightly changed.

notes.title: Lost in memory update V2.1
notes.content:

-Fixed the bug were if you pause the game well a text box is open the game soft locks.
